Ring Out - credits and disclaimer
=================================

Ring Out was assembled by Jack Poison with substantial AI-assisted coding,
debugging, and packaging. This Windows revival is maintained in the Ell fork.
It is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
connected to the companies or upstream projects named below.

No game image, game executable, extracted asset, save file, or precompiled
per-game module is distributed. Users provide their own GameCube image and
build the derived module locally.

Major upstream work
-------------------

  Dolphin Emulator Project
    GameCube hardware emulation, graphics, audio, input, savestates, and the
    Vulkan frontend used by the runtime. Primarily GPL-2.0-or-later.
    https://dolphin-emu.org/

  ExpansionPak RecompCore / ModernGekko
    StaticRecomp integration and the chassis that hosts recompiled GameCube
    code in Dolphin. GPL-3.0-or-later.
    https://github.com/ExpansionPak/RecompCore
    https://github.com/ExpansionPak/ModernGekko

  ExpansionPak DolRecomp
    GameCube PowerPC static recompiler included as tools/dolrecomp.exe.
    GPL-3.0-or-later.
    https://github.com/ExpansionPak/DolRecomp

  Dear ImGui, SDL, LLVM, CMake, Ninja, Python, and other dependencies
    Their own copyright and licence notices are retained in LICENSES/ or the
    bundled toolchain and summarized in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt.

  Bandai Namco Entertainment
    The original game and its assets. They are not included or redistributed;
    all rights in that material remain with their respective owners.

Corresponding source
--------------------

The exact source revision for the shipped Ring Out, ModernGekko/RecompCore,
Dolphin, DolRecomp, launcher, setup, and packaging code is linked in SOURCE.txt.
The release tag and its source archive are offered from the same GitHub release
as the binaries. Preserve SOURCE.txt, LICENSES/, and these notices if you pass
the package on. Anything setup derives from a user's disc must not be shared.
